etsy.title: Screen Free Winter Break Planner Printable, Family Screen Time Agreement, Boredom Jar, Kids Screen Time Rules, Christmas Break Activities
etsy.description:
Long school break, short fuses, and the tablet keeps calling? This printable planner gives the break a calm shape, so screens become one part of the day, not the whole day. ❄️

✨ WHAT'S INSIDE (9 pages)
• Family break agreement with simple screen rules to tick or write your own
• 14-day break rhythm planner: outside, quiet, together and screen time for each day
• 32 boredom jar slips with screen-free ideas (cut, fold, put in a jar)
• 10-5-1 screen-off countdown cards + landing activities list
• "Good screen time" list for movie nights and video calls
• End-of-break reflection page

👧👦 For families with kids ages 3 to 12.

This planner is a companion to the book "Give Them Back Their Wonder" by Clara Whitfield (Gentle Life Guides), available on Amazon. The planner works on its own too.

HOW IT WORKS
INSTANT DIGITAL DOWNLOAD. No physical item will be shipped. US Letter + A4 PDF included.

PLEASE NOTE
A planning aid for families, not professional advice. For personal use only. Please do not resell or share the files.

Designed by our small shop, AureliaVenn, with the help of AI tools.
